title: 49ers WR Mike Evans’ quad strain believed to be ‘not too serious’

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: 49ers WR Mike Evans’ quad strain believed to be ‘not too serious’
sources.description: The hits keep coming for the San Francisco 49ers. Wide receiver Mike Evans isn’t practicing on Monday due to a quad strain. Rookie running back Kaelon Black has an adductor injury and will also miss Monday’s session. Depending on the grade of the strain, Evans could miss anywhere from one week to multiple months. If […]
